suggested_resolution.title: Telugu/Hindi search returning zero results: analysis-icu plugin missing on new OpenSearch nodes
suggested_resolution.root_cause: The Packer template refactor for AMI opensearch-2.19-bb-v12 dropped the step that installs the analysis-icu and analysis-phonetic plugins. Shards allocated to the three new os-data-v12 nodes could not build the bb_indic analyzer (icu_tokenizer), so Telugu and Hindi queries hit shard failures and returned zero results.
worked: Excluded the new nodes from shard allocation so shards moved back to healthy nodes: PUT _cluster/settings {"transient":{"cluster.routing.allocation.exclude._name":"os-data-v12-*"}}
Rebuilt the AMI with analysis-icu and analysis-phonetic installed (bin/opensearch-plugin install analysis-icu analysis-phonetic) and added a Packer test that asserts both plugins are present
failed: Rolling restart of the os-data-v12 nodes: plugins are baked into the AMI, so restarts changed nothing
suggested_resolution.notes: Zero-result rate back to 4% about 9 minutes after the allocation exclude. Check GET _cat/plugins on any new node group before letting it take shards.

demo_note: Brand-new failure mode: the agent has no memory of it. Resolve it with 'Resolve & teach' to store the fix in Hindsight, then triage ALT-506.
